messages.0°为水平视线，正值从水面上方看向湖盆，负值从水面下方仰看湖底。滑块限于±89°: At 0°, the view is horizontal. Positive values look down toward the basin from above the water surface; negative values look up at the lake bed from below the surface. The slider is limited to ±89° to avoid the vertical-camera singularity. The top-down and bottom-up presets use ±90° and synchronize the slider to the nearest position. This changes camera elevation only; vertical exaggeration is controlled separately.
messages.正值让画面中的模型上移，负值下移。只平移镜头，不改变数据或模型几何；与镜头仰角、: Positive values move the model upward on screen; negative values move it downward. This translates the camera only and does not change data or model geometry. It is controlled separately from camera elevation and vertical exaggeration. Resetting the view recenters it.
messages.本案例为结构四边形网格；默认以稳定对角线将当前有效湿四边形显示为三角面。这是派生: This case uses a structured quadrilateral grid. By default, each currently valid wet quadrilateral is shown as triangular faces split along a stable diagonal. This is derived display triangulation, not solver-native triangle topology; original cell values, coordinates, and wet mask are unchanged. The legend follows the current frame and lists the wet cells and display edges actually drawn; rendering is refused without trustworthy topology. Continuous surface is a lighter alternative for large grids or playback; hover continues to report the original cell-centre value.
messages.本案例为结构四边形网格；三角面模式按稳定对角线拆分当前帧有效湿四边形。单层 3D: This case uses a structured quadrilateral grid. Triangular mode splits each valid wet quadrilateral in the current frame along a stable diagonal. By default, single-layer 3D playback shows 2 triangles per wet quadrilateral; triangles are added only when subdivision is explicitly requested. This display triangulation is derived from the actual wet grid and is not a native solver triangle mesh. The legend reports the wet quadrilaterals and triangles used in each frame, plus deduplicated display edges. Drawing is refused when trustworthy wet-grid topology is unavailable. The mesh follows valid wet cells during playback. Continuous waterbody mode is the default for playback performance; orthogonal or triangular display meshes take longer to render. Corner interpolation in continuous mode is display only; hover values remain the original cell-centre values.
messages.拓扑说明：求解器的有效水体单元为四边形；三角模式按单元索引稳定选择对角线。单层: Topology: Valid solver water cells are quadrilaterals; triangular mode selects a diagonal deterministically from cell indices. Single-layer 3D playback shows 2 triangles per wet quadrilateral by default; additional display triangles require explicit subdivision. Legend values reflect the mesh actually drawn in the current frame. This is auditable display triangulation, not solver-native triangle topology; drawing is refused without trustworthy wet-grid topology. This setting does not change solver topology or original variable values. Sampled meshes are labelled as sampled display meshes. When land elevation is unavailable, only known dry cells are drawn as a neutral plane.
